Recurring

The rhythm we keep.

These services and gatherings happen every week unless otherwise noted.

Every Sunday 8:00 AM · Holy Eucharist Rite I
10:00 AM · Choral Eucharist Rite II
10:00 AM · Sunday School (Sept–June)
Every Wednesday 12:10 PM · Healing Eucharist
10:00 AM · Bible study (Sept–May)
Every Thursday 7:00 PM · Choir rehearsal (Sept–May; light summer schedule)
Every Friday 7:00 AM · Morning Prayer (chapel)
Every Saturday 5:00 PM · Evening Prayer (chapel)
9:00 AM · Altar Guild (rotating teams)
First Wednesday 5:30 PM · Community dinner (free, all welcome)
Second Tuesday 6:30 PM · Vestry meeting (open to all members)
Second Saturday 9:30 AM · Daughters of the King chapter
First Saturday in May & October 9 AM · Property workday
Sunday evenings (Sept–May) 5–7 PM · Youth Group (grades 6–12)
